{{Quote|Join Thaum Rystra and ally yourselves with me! The galaxy will fall to our might. I shall rule, with you as my chiefs.|Valik Kodank, to the New Republic agents that she lured to the Temple of Pain|<ref name="Light and Dark" />}}
'''Valik Kodank''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Near-Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. The consort and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the minor [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Janton Belos]], Kodank grew in power and founded her own [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith sect]] and constructed a [[Temple of Pain|Sith temple]] in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]]. However, circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], while attempting a ritual to relocate her [[Sith temple/Legends|temple]] into the heart of the system's [[Star/Legends|sun]], Kodank was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and transformed into a Sith spirit. Kodank's temple was transported into the depthes of the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]] and she abode there for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], seeking someone whom she could manipulate into helping her regain her physical form.

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kodank seduced the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Thaum Rystra]] into her service, taking him as her apprentice. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] spirit tasked Rystra with restoring her to life and around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] the pair lured a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to her Tascollan Nebula temple so that she could attempt to possess the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Sha'lia]]. The agents subsequently defeated Kodank and destroyed her spirit.

==Biography==
===Deception and downfall===
Valik Kodank was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Near-Human]]<ref name="Light and Dark" /> who served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. Kodank became the consort and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the minor [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> [[Janton Belos]],<ref name="Light and Dark" /> who [[Sith training|trained]] her in the arts of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in an effort to content her and keep her attracted to him. As Kodank developed her strength in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] she concealed her power from her [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] and in secret founded a [[Sith cult/Legends|sect]] of her own followers<ref name="Child of Light" /> that included a number of [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolytes]].<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Behind Belos' back she took another Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] as her lover. With her new companion's support she covertly channeled resources into the raising of<ref name="Child of Light" /> the [[Temple of Pain]],<ref name="Light and Dark" /> a large [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith temple]] sited in a [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>, far from the attention of the other Sith, to serve as her power base.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="5000 BBY" /> amidst the collapse of the Sith Empire in the aftermath of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] conflict with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Kodank and her lover seized a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and fled to her temple, taking with them several powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith relics]]. Kodank arrived<ref name="Child of Light" /> at the Temple of Pain<ref name="Light and Dark" /> to find her stronghold nearing completion and was joined at the temple by her sect of followers.<ref name="Child of Light" /> Some lavishly-decorated chambers in the citadel were designated as Kodank's personal quarters and she kept there a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] capable of enhancing the power of its user. She also used the temple's [[Room of Change]] [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] to conduct experiments and studied a [[Sith holocron (Tascollan Nebula)|Sith holocron]] housed in a small chamber in the temple to further her knowledge.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

Desiring to transfer her stronghold into the center of the star system's only [[Star/Legends|sun]], Kodank and her lover placed the Sith artifacts they had brought to the citadel into<ref name="Child of Light" /> the Temple of Pain's<ref name="Light and Dark" /> central chamber and activated them, hoping to wield the relics' strength. However, the artifacts did not respond as Kodank had expected and the power she unleashed [[Death/Legends|took the lives]] of Kodank's lover and followers and transported the her deep inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]].<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Kodank herself was also killed and transformed into a [[Force ghost/Legends|dark side spirit]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> lacking physical form, with her essence tied to a large, triangular obelisk in the Temple of Pain that had been the focus of the ritual she had invoked.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

===A new apprentice===
{{Quote|I know what you desire, Thaum Rystra, and I can give it to you. Become my servant and the power of the Force shall be yours.|Valik Kodank, as she seduced Thaum Rystra to the dark side of the Force|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Following her physical death, Kodank felt in her mind the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] mocking her and revelling in her helplessness, feeding off her emotions. Over the [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] her demise, she sought to make contact with someone who she could manipulate into helping her to regain her physical form. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Force-sensitive [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Thaum Rystra]] ventured<ref name="Child of Light" /> to the Tascollan Nebula<ref name="Light and Dark" /> on an assignment to chart the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula's]] star system. Kodank reached out to him in the Force, claiming to know his desires<ref name="Child of Light" /> to destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and promised to teach him the ways of the Sith and help him to gain true power in the Force if he came to her. Guided by her voice, Rystra traveled through the nebula and made his way into the depths<ref name="Child of Light" /> of the Temple of Pain. In the large chamber of the temple containing the obelisk to which her spirit was tied,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> the Kodank manifested and Rystra surrendered to her will and acceded to serve as her apprentice.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Rystra studied under the Sith spirit's tutelage, developing into a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], and he became utterly loyal to Kodank.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> The spirit reasoned that restoring her physical presence was beyond Rystra's capabilities and she devised to exploit the powers of [[Caeleb]], the prophesied "Child of Light," a [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] strong in the Force through whom other Force users could access unlimited [[Force energy]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> she dispatched Rystra to capture Caeleb for her,<ref name="Child of Light" /> . After Rystra returned to Kodank unsuccessful, she was wrathful<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and sent him on a new errand to locate the ancient [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side relic]] the [[Soulsaber]], an artfact capable of enhancing her dark side power.<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="Dates" /> Rystra recovered the relic the [[Soulsaber]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and brought it to her at the Temple of Pain.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

===Seduction of Maric Tovar===
Over the next three [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Rystra trained under Kodank at the Temple of Pain and she taught him much about the arts of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]]. The Sith spirit filled Rystra's head with so much new knowledge that her apprentice had difficulty [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]], leaving him more susceptible to her manipulations. Rystra told his master of a group of Rebel Alliance agents who had hindered his efforts to apprehend Caeleb and capture the Soulsaber. Upon learning of the strong Force-sensitivity of one of the Rebels, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Sha'lia]], Kodank plotted to possess the Twi'lek's body, judging Sha'lia to be the perfect target for her to occupy. To that end, she directed Rystra to conduct research on how best she could
take control of Sha'lia's body.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

As an additional ploy to ensure that Sha'lia was delivered to her, Kodank befriended another of Rystra's Rebel adversaries, [[Maric Tovar]], a timid Force-sensitive [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who held romantic intentions toward the Twi'lek Force adept.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Circa [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> while Tovar was conducting a covert mission for [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]], Kodank reached out into his mind and promised him great power and Sha'lia's love if he brought the team of Rebels to her. Kodank did not reveal her name or identity to Tovar and kept her interactions with engineer secret from Rystra. Tovar agreed to her bargain and Kodank instructed him in the use of the Force. As his training advanced, she promised the Rebel engineer that they would meet in person soon and that when he did their deal would be complete and Sha'lia would be his.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

===Confrontation at the Temple of Pain===
{{Quote|Are you sure they will find us?''"<br />"''Yes, my master. They cannot miss the clues. Everything is proceeding as you predicted.''"<br />"''Good. Make sure our friends are welcomed&hellip;appropriately.''"<br />"''As you command, my lady. It shall be done.''"<br />"''Yes, exactly as I have foreseen. |Valik Kodank and Thaum Rystra, on luring their New Republic agent adversaries to the Temple of Pain|<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref>}}
Her plans to ensnare Sha'lia all set,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Kodank instructed Rystra to lure the Rebel agents, who now served the Rebel Alliance's successor the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], to the Temple of Pain. Kodank foresaw that her plan would be successful and by leaking intelligence concerning his location, Rystra drew Sha'lia, Tovar and the other agents in their team to the Tascollan Nebula. As the operatives approached Kodank ordered Rystra to make preparations for their arrival. After the agents landed at the temple and progressed into the depths of the structure, Kodank conjured an illusory version of Rystra sitting on a throne-like chair to welcome the agents. The Sith spirit's Dark Jedi phantom delayed the agents by proffering a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and asking Sha'lia if she had yet found her place in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. To deceive the operatives into venturing further into the temple, Kodank arranged for the sound of an explosion to blast the room and had the illusory Rystra falsely claimed that all starships in the temple had been blown up and that the operatives only means of escape was to press on. Kodank then faded away the phantom Rystra and dispatched a group of [[Sith Elite Warbot|Sith war droids]] to attack the agents. Once the operatives had defeated the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Kodank sent a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] message to Tovar instructing him to await her orders and promising him that he would soon have all that he desired.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

{{RPG|[[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']]}}
The New Republic agents uncovered the Sith holocron that Kodank kept within her her temple and one of the holocron's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeepers]], the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bavik Vannor]] regaled them with Kodank's personal history. Another gatekeeper, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Sansin Koriss]], also revealed to the operatives that Kodank feared the Sith amulet kept in her personal chambers.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

In a large chamber deep within the temple Kodank awaited with Thaum Rystra the agents' arrival. Kodank was keen render Sha'lia unconscious before attempting to possess the Twi'lek and she also ordered Rystra to treat all of the agents other than Sha'lia as expendable. When New Republic agents reached the chamber, Kodank and Rystra observed unseen as the operatives fought off several Sith [[Guardian Spirit]]s, manifesting and revealing her presence only once the spirits had been defeated. Kodank entreated the agents to join her and Rystra to serve as her chiefs and help her rule the galaxy, or else be destroyed. The operatives rejected her demand and a battle broke out and Kodak summoned a [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydra]] to assist her in the fight. She also beseeched Tovar to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] Sha'lia for her. The agents ultimately prevailed and vanquished Kodank's spirit and defeated Rystra. Following her demise the, Temple of Pain collapsed and the agents fled the citadel.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Very well. You have then decided to oppose me. For that, you will pay.|Valik Kodank, to the New Republic agents that she lured to the Temple of Pain|<ref name="Light and Dark" />}}
Kodank possessed an exotic beauty and wore loose, [[Silk/Legends|silky]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] clad with jewels.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Intelligent and ruthless,<ref name="Child of Light" /> she was adept at deceit and lies<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and during her lifetime exploited her partner<ref name="Child of Light" /> Janton Belos<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and her other Sith Lord lover to mastermind her rise to power.<ref name="Child of Light" /> She ruled her minions through through fear and cunning<ref name="Light and Dark" /> but eventually her ambition led her to overreach herself and she was transformed into a Sith spirit.<ref name="Child of Light" />

In the aftermath of her death, Kodank's spirit was left feeling emotional. In her incorporeal form she radiated the dark side and could not physically interact with the world around her, being limited to floating around only within the temple that she had built for herself.<ref name="Child of Light" /> She became vulnerable to attacks from those harnessing the power of Force artifacts and therefore feared the Sith amulet kept in her personal chambers as the relic could be used destroy her. Her spirit was however immune to certain Force-based attacks including [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and the use of the Force [[Telekinesis/Legends|to grip or push]] her.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

As a spirit Kodank manipulated others as she had in life, convincing Thaum Rystra<ref name="Child of Light" /> and Maric Tovar to serve her cause,<ref name="Light and Dark" /> and was willing to exploit the innocent child Caeleb to further her aims.<ref name="Child of Light" /> She was eager to regain her physical form and had aspirations to rule the galaxy. When Rystra lured his New Republic agent adversaries to the Temple of Pain she relished their arrival, smiling for the first time in millennia.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|There is much power in your group. Yes, much power.|Valik Kodank, to the New Republic agents that she lured to the Temple of Pain|<ref name="Light and Dark" />}}
Kodank practiced the dark side of the Force and under the training of her mentor and lover<ref name="Child of Light" /> Janton Belos<ref name="Light and Dark" /> quickly mastered the arts of the Sith.<ref name="Child of Light" /> She was proficient in Sith alchemy and Sith sorcery, and was also versed in the use of the Force to move objects, [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] things, [[Mind trick/Legends|affect the minds]] of others and cast illusions. The Sith was also familiar with the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] [[Battlemind]], [[Drain Knowledge]], [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]] and [[Force empathy/Legends|Force empathy]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

Upon becoming a Sith spirit, Kodank lost the capacity to use some of her Force powers, including battlemind and her abilities to grip objects and perform Sith alchemy. Despite her spirit being tied to the Temple of Pain, she could through the Force telepathically communicate with other individuals over vast distances and she used this power to project her voice and images of herself into the mind of Maric Tovar when enlisting him as her servant. She was also capable of manifesting and controlling phantom illusory versions of other individuals. She was [[Language/Legends|multi-lingual]] and in addition to being able to speak and [[Writing/Legends|write]] [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] and [[Sith (language)|Sith]] she could also speak the languages [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]] and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Valik Kodank was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and served as one of the main antagonists of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]], a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] trilogy of [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventures published by [[RPGA]]. She was first mentioned in the opening adventure of the saga, ''[[Child of Light]]'', in [[2000]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> and appeared in the final adventure of the trilogy, [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], in [[2002]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

An inconsistency exists between and outline of the ''Child of Light'' saga set out in ''Child of Light''<ref name="Child of Light" /> and ''Light and Dark''<ref name="Light and Dark" /> regarding the means through which Kodank attempts to regain physical form.<ref name="Child of Light" /> In ''Child of Light'' it is stated that in the final adventure of the trilogy, Thaum Rystra attempts to return Kodank's to life by drawing Force energy from the Child of Light Caeleb and using the Soulsaber to convert this power into dark side energy sufficient to restore her physical body. However, in ''Light and Dark'', Kodank seeks to regain physical form by possessing the Twi'lek Sha'lia and Caeleb and the Soulsaber have no role in her scheme. This article presents her resurrection attempt in line with the events depicted in ''Light and Dark''.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

In the ''Child of Light'' saga, the players roleplay as the New Republic agents that Kodank draws to the Temple of Pain and her confrontation with the them can play out in a number of ways depending upon the players' actions and decisions. During her fight with the agents it is possible for Kodank to attempt to take control of Sha'lia's body and if she is unsuccessful at possessing the Twi'lek it is possible that she instead tries to inhabit the body of Maric Tovar or that of the former [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial senator]] [[Mina Dhori Tolas]], another of the agents. The battle can conclude with the player characters vanquishing Kodank's spirit through either stabbing her with a Force-imbued [[Knife/Legends|knife]], destroying her with the Sith amulet from Kodank's chambers or by obliterating the obelisk to which her spirit was linked. It is alternately possible for Kodank to succeed at possessing Sha'lia and for the Sith spirit and Thaum Rystra to defeat the New Republic agents.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
